[[:File:The Catacombs map.jpg|Non-interactive map]] | ingame name = The Catacombs | game link type 0 = explorable | game link num 0 = 145 }} [[The Catacombs]] is a large network of tombs in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]]. They connect to several places in the kingdom of Ascalon, and have been used as a way of transportation. The catacombs are infested with [[Undead]] spirits, making them dangerous to venture into. Poisonous [[Swamp Water]] is also found in certain areas of the catacombs. Adventurers who do brave the poisonous water and the swarms of undead are treated to beautiful murals depicting the [[Gods of Tyria]]. ==Shrines== ;Statue of [[Grenth]] * In a recess just off the raised area where [[Paulus]] finds the [[Unusual Artifact|artifact]] in [[A Monk's Mission]]. * In the area behind [[Necromancer Munne]] where there is a large gathering of [[Gargoyle (NPC)|gargoyles]]. ==[[Interactive object]]s== *[[Flame Geyser]] *[[Remembrance Brazier]] ==Quests available== *[[Necromancer Munne]] **[[The Necromancer's Novice]] {{preq|n|primary=y|secondary=n}} **[[Rites of Remembrance]] *[[Oberan the Reviled]] **[[The Accursed Path]] {{preq|n}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s *{{n}} 5 [[Necromancer Munne]] *{{n}} 2 [[Oberan the Reviled]] Humans ([[Ascalon Army]]) *{{mo}} 5 [[Academy Monk]]s [[Ghost]]s *{{w}} 10 [[Restless Spirit (pre-Searing)|Restless Spirits]] ====Services==== *{{x}} 1 [[Gwynn]] ([[collector]] for 3 [[Skeletal Limb]]s) *{{x}} 1 [[Karleen]] (collector for 5 [[Gargoyle Skull]]s) (not during [[The Power of Blood]]) ===Foes=== [[Arachnid]]s *{{r}} 2 [[Deadly Crypt Spider]] [[Devourer]]s *{{w}} 1 [[Carrion Devourer]] *{{w}} 2 [[Snapping Devourer]] *{{x}} 0 [[Diseased Devourer]] [[Gargoyle]]s *{{me}} 1 [[Gargoyle (NPC)|Gargoyle]] *{{me}} 3 [[Shatter Gargoyle]] [[Nightmare]]s *{{n}} 3 [[Crypt Fiend]] *{{n}} 4 [[Tomb Nightmare]] [[Skeleton]]s *{{w}} 1 [[Restless Corpse]] *{{n}} 3 [[Raging Cadaver]] ====Bosses==== Skeleton *{{w}} 5 [[Skullreaver]] ==Gallery== File:"Catacomb" concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Daniel Dociu]]. File:SS-catacombs1.jpg|A mural of Grenth File:SS-catacombs-crypt.jpg|A crypt deep inside the Catacombs File:SS-catacombs-hall.jpg|A grand, candle lined hall File:SS-catacombs-pit.jpg|A seemingly bottomless pit in the deepest part of the Catacombs ==Notes== {{gw2w|Ascalonian Catacombs}} *These quests will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[A Monk's Mission]] **[[The Power of Blood]] **[[Vanguard Annihilation: Undead]] **[[Vanguard Rescue: Save the Ascalonian Noble]] *The quest [[Rites of Remembrance]] will spawn several allied lvl10 [[Restless Spirit (pre-Searing)|Restless Spirit]]s which will help you during the quest [[Vanguard Annihilation: Undead]] and [[A Monk's Mission]]. You do not need to keep the [[Votive Candle (pre-Searing)|Votive Candle]]s in your inventory. *[[Collector]] [[Karleen]] has the upgrade [[Krytan armor]] foot gear for all professions in pre-Searing. *The catacombs are a great place for [[Smiting Prayers|Smiting]] Monks to quickly gain levels - luring all of the creatures into one small area before unleashing [[Symbol of Wrath]] is particularly effective. *While navigating the passageway towards Oberan the Reviled (usually during the quest [[Charr in the Catacombs]]), if you have the [[Igneous Summoning Stone|Fire Imp]] active, it can get caught trying to attack the foes in the other passageway. Two ways to avoid this are (1) to stick to the right hand side of the passageway you are in, (2) to go down the other passageway before-hand and clear them out first. If the imp get aggro, (3) use a non-[[projectile]] spell such as [[Fire Storm]] to clear out the foes in the passageway through the wall or (4) do the whole walk around to clear the path and unstuck the imp. *Near the exit into Ashford Abbey, there are three broken staircases leading down to the resurrection shrine. The gap between the middle staircase and the right-hand side one (when looking down), despite being nearly vertical, can be freely walked down and up. ==Trivia== *Under the bridge near Karleen, close to the [[Green Hills County]] portal, there is a big skeleton that seems to be the one of a dragon. *The background music is "Ascension Song" from the Guild Wars: Prophecies soundtrack. There's another background music which is a hidden track that can only be heard in-game. {{Explorable areas in pre-Searing Ascalon}} [[de:Die Katakomben]]
